title: Agenvoy@v1.3.17
description:
v1.3.16 -> v1.3.17

Summary

fetch_page now caches the original page and filters it against each task with the decision model at delivery, instead of cutting every page at 100 KiB; unrelated pages are withheld, long pages keep only related blocks, and pages over 1 MiB are checked within their first 1 MiB. calculate is rebuilt for exact and correctly ordered arithmetic, and the internal tool packages are reorganized around registration.

翻譯

fetch_page 改為快取原始頁面，回傳前依每次的任務以 decision model 篩選，不再把每頁固定截在 100 KiB；無關的頁面會被排除，長頁面只留相關段落，超過 1 MiB 的頁面只在開頭 1 MiB 內查找。calculate 重寫為精確且運算順序正確的算術，內部工具套件也依註冊方式重新整理。

Changes

FIX

  • Rebuild the calculate parser: ^ is now power with the highest precedence and right associativity (2+3^2 = 11, -2^2 = -4), integer results past int64 stay exact instead of clamping, literals are decimal only, fixed-arity functions reject extra arguments, NaN and Inf are errors, and min／max／abs keep large integers exact
  • Fix fetch_page returning broken output: UTF-8 cut mid-character and JSON truncated into invalid JSON no longer happen, and normal pages whose URL contains 404／403／410 (e.g. /wiki/HTTP_404) are no longer reported as not found and blocked for 90 days; error pages are detected by HTTP status ≥ 400 or the error-page title list
  • Fix related pages being hidden: the whole-page relevance check no longer judges long pages by their opening only, so a page whose answer sits further down is returned instead of withheld
  • Fix fetch_page keep_links returning no links (markdown dropped every link with its text, json flattened link nodes) by upgrading go-browser to v0.3.5
  • Fix GitHub Copilot MAI Code 2／MAI Code 2 Flash failing with no model endpoints available: models listing both /chat/completions and /responses now use /responses, by upgrading go-llm-router to v0.10.5

翻譯

  • 重寫 calculate 解析器：^ 為次方、優先序最高且右結合（2+3^2 = 11、-2^2 = -4），超過 int64 的整數結果維持精確、不再被截到上限，只接受十進位字面值，固定參數的函式會拒絕多餘參數，NaN 與 Inf 視為錯誤，min／max／abs 保留大整數精度
  • 修正 fetch_page 回傳壞掉的內容：不再切壞 UTF-8 字元、不再把 JSON 截成不合法格式；網址含 404／403／410 的正常頁面（如 /wiki/HTTP_404）不再被判為找不到並封鎖 90 天，錯誤頁改依 HTTP 狀態 ≥ 400 或錯誤頁標題判斷
  • 修正相關頁面被隱藏：整頁相關性判斷不再只看長頁面的開頭，答案在後段的頁面會正常回傳
  • 升級 go-browser 至 v0.3.5，修正 fetch_page 開啟 keep_links 時沒有任何連結（markdown 連同連結文字整段消失、json 的連結節點被攤平）
  • 升級 go-llm-router 至 v0.10.5，修正 GitHub Copilot MAI Code 2／MAI Code 2 Flash 回 no model endpoints available：同時列出 /chat/completions 與 /responses 的模型改走 /responses

UPDATE

  • fetch_page caches the original page with only noise removed and filters it against the current task with the decision model on every delivery, fresh or cached: short pages are judged whole, longer pages keep only related blocks (tables and headings kept), a page with nothing related is withheld, and the 100 KiB cut is gone; markdown and json follow the same rules, with json cached as {title, tree} and returned as the node array
  • fetch_page pages over 1 MiB are checked within their first 1 MiB and keep only blocks that directly answer the task; if none do, the agent is told the site is too large and to use download_file; html over 1 MiB is refused
  • Rename tool parameters: fetch_page and download_file take output_type instead of type, and download_file takes link instead of url; MCP or script callers must send the new names
  • download_file streams to a temp file and renames it into place, render=true saves the full page with no size limit, and the result drops ok and status_code
  • find_tools ranks fallback tools (search_web, fetch_page, download_file, http_request, generate_image, generate_audio) after other matches and marks them system_default; public_api_list is hidden from find_tools listing
  • generate_image and generate_audio are registered in every process (TUI and CLI included), not only the daemon; upgrade go-pkg to v0.14.0

翻譯

  • fetch_page 快取只去除雜訊的原始頁面，每次回傳前（不論新抓或讀快取）依當下任務以 decision model 篩選：短頁整頁判斷，長頁只留相關段落（表格與標題保留），完全無關的頁面不回傳，並移除 100 KiB 截斷；markdown 與 json 規則相同，json 以 {title, tree} 快取、以節點陣列回傳
  • fetch_page 超過 1 MiB 的頁面只在開頭 1 MiB 內查找，只保留直接回答任務的段落；找不到時告知網站太大並建議改用 download_file；超過 1 MiB 的 html 直接拒絕
  • 工具參數改名：fetch_page 與 download_file 的 type 改為 output_type，download_file 的 url 改為 link；經 MCP 或腳本呼叫者需改用新名稱
  • download_file 改為串流寫入暫存檔後再改名就位，render=true 整頁存檔不限大小，回傳移除 ok 與 status_code
  • find_tools 將保底工具（search_web、fetch_page、download_file、http_request、generate_image、generate_audio）排在其他命中結果之後並標記 system_default；public_api_list 不再出現在 find_tools 清單
  • generate_image 與 generate_audio 改在所有程序註冊（含 TUI 與 CLI），不再只限 daemon；go-pkg 升級至 v0.14.0

DOC

  • Align doc/doc, doc/architecture and doc/optimization with the current code, and add doc/decision/fetchPage measuring fetch_page before and after decision filtering

翻譯

  • doc/doc、doc/architecture、doc/optimization 對齊目前程式碼，並新增 doc/decision/fetchPage，實測 fetch_page 加入 decision 篩選前後的差異

Scope

  • internal/tools/fetchPage/ — FIX, UPDATE, REFACTOR
  • internal/tools/calculate/ — FIX
  • internal/tools/ (root, command/, cron/, searchWeb/, toolAdapter/, toolSkill/, register/) — UPDATE, REFACTOR
  • internal/runtime/chatbot/tool/, internal/runtime/mcp/, internal/runtime/routes/handler/ — REFACTOR
  • internal/agents/exec/, internal/utils/, cmd/app/, configs/ — UPDATE, REFACTOR
  • go.mod — FIX, UPDATE (go-browser v0.3.5, go-llm-router v0.10.5, go-pkg v0.14.0)
  • doc/ — DOC

title: Java4Shell no OpenJDK pode permitir execução remota via Base64
description:
Falha Java4Shell no OpenJDK

Pesquisadores da Calif divulgaram a Java4Shell, vulnerabilidade CVE-2026-114938 de corrupção de memória no decodificador Base64 AVX-512 do OpenJDK. A falha recebeu classificação de gravidade 9,2 e pode permitir que invasores provoquem uma gravação fora dos limites da heap.

O problema pode ser acionado com uma string malformada terminada em um sinal de igual isolado. De acordo com o relato, essa entrada pode levar ao vazamento de memória sensível ou, em determinadas condições, à execução remota de código antes da autenticação.

Possíveis efeitos da exploração

A gravação fora dos limites da heap é o mecanismo descrito pelos pesquisadores para explicar os riscos da vulnerabilidade. Entre os resultados possíveis estão a exposição de dados sensíveis armazenados na memória e a execução de código remotamente sem autenticação prévia.

Jira, Jenkins e Keycloak estão entre as plataformas citadas como exemplos de sistemas que podem ser afetados. O alerta não confirma ataques bem-sucedidos nesses produtos; descreve os possíveis impactos da falha em plataformas importantes.

Atualização de segurança

Embora a Calif considere a vulnerabilidade difícil de explorar, a Oracle publicou uma atualização crítica de segurança na terça-feira. A Agência de Segurança Cibernética e de Infraestrutura dos Estados Unidos (CISA) também pediu que as organizações atualizem seus sistemas imediatamente.

Equipes responsáveis por ambientes OpenJDK devem priorizar a aplicação da atualização de segurança e verificar os sistemas que dependem do decodificador afetado. O risco descrito inclui tanto a exposição de memória sensível quanto a possibilidade de execução remota antes da autenticação.

Risco de exposição prolongada

Os pesquisadores da Calif alertaram que sistemas vulneráveis podem permanecer expostos por cinco a dez anos, diante da lentidão com que algumas organizações corrigem sua infraestrutura. O intervalo é um alerta sobre o tempo que falhas sem correção podem continuar presentes.

A recomendação da CISA para atualizar imediatamente reforça a importância de tratar a Java4Shell como prioridade de segurança. Organizações que mantêm sistemas vulneráveis devem aplicar a atualização crítica da Oracle para reduzir o período em que a falha pode ser explorada.

Confira mais em: https://guiadeti.com.br/noticias/falha-java4shell-openjdk-execucao-remota-codigo-base64/

title: Free tools I actually use for frontend work — all browser, no install
description:
Free tools for frontend work — all browser, no install

I keep a folder of tiny utilities for the annoying 30-second tasks that break flow. All free, all local — nothing sends your data anywhere.

Layout & CSS

  • Aspect ratio calculator — give it a resolution, get the ratio and clean scale targets for video/images.
  • Fluid type calculator — min/max sizes + viewport range, outputs the clamp() line to paste straight into CSS.
  • Palette contrast grid — paste your palette, get WCAG AA/AAA pass/fail for every pair at once.
  • SVG ViewBox planner — figure out viewBox coordinates before you write the SVG, not after it breaks.

Debugging & inspection

  • Text character inspector — paste a string, see every invisible character: zero-width spaces, smart quotes, BOMs, NBSPs.
  • URL parameter inspector — decode any long URL, see every parameter and what tracking tags are attached.
  • Redirect map checker — check redirect chains for loops and dead ends after migrations.
  • Screenshot pages — quick page captures without opening devtools.

Generation

  • Password generator — length + character sets, instant strength read.
  • Lorem ipsum generator — filler text sized to the space it needs to fill.
  • Morse code translator — for the occasional puzzle or easter egg.

All static single-page tools on free hosting. Nothing tracked. If one saves you a Google search, it did its job.

title: Amazon OpenSearch Memory is now generally available
description:
Today, AWS announced the general availability of Amazon OpenSearch Memory, a new serverless capability in Amazon OpenSearch Service for adding persistent memory to AI agents. OpenSearch Memory stores agent interactions as searchable events, derives useful memories, and retrieves relevant context across sessions, so agents can recall prior decisions, earlier interactions, and user preferences without replaying the full conversation history to the model. Customers can give agents long-term memory without provisioning infrastructure or building separate extraction, indexing, consolidation, and retrieval systems.

OpenSearch Memory stores the original events verbatim, makes them searchable within seconds, and asynchronously derives structured memories. It manages the full memory lifecycle, including extraction, embedding, indexing, consolidation (adding, updating, or skipping memories as new information arrives), and retrieval using keyword, semantic, and hybrid search. Customers control access with AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) for each memory store, with actor and session scoping, and can set expiration periods for events and memories. Because it is serverless, there are no clusters to provision, instance types to choose, or indexes to create, and capacity for extraction and search scales automatically.

Amazon OpenSearch Memory is available today in US East (N. Virginia, Ohio), US West (Oregon), Europe (Frankfurt), and Asia Pacific (Tokyo) Regions. For pricing details about Amazon OpenSearch Memory, visit the pricing page.

To learn more about Amazon OpenSearch Memory, see the technical documentation and launch blog. You can get started by visiting the technical launch blog that details how to add persistent memory to your agents with Amazon OpenSearch Memory.
